key_counterexample.statement: Phase402 and Phase403 both used a negative meta line forbidding analysis, self-evaluation, title, editorial advice and second version, yet Phase402 output contract was CLEAR while Phase403 BLOCKED.
key_counterexample.consequence: Negative meta vocabulary alone is not supported as a sufficient primary cause.

evidence: Phase403 literary payload successfully produced prose but the chat response still had freedom to prepend a generic label and append post-prose assistant text.
The runner specified content behavior but did not define the entire response surface as a closed transaction with line-1 and response-termination invariants.
residual_diagnoses.causal_hypothesis: A content request plus prohibitions leaves ordinary chat-wrapper behavior available; the response needs a positive whole-surface contract.

evidence: Phase403 appended three optimization suggestions after the fiction passage.
Similar trailing editorial advice appeared in earlier isolated writer attempts.
These lines occur after the prose has already reached a natural stop.
residual_diagnoses.causal_hypothesis: Once the narrative completion is internally judged finished, generic assistant/helpfulness behavior can re-enter unless termination is itself part of the response contract.

evidence: Phase403 begins with the generic category label '小说正文'.
The requested artifact is explicitly a Chinese fiction passage, which makes a helpful label a plausible chat formatting behavior.
residual_diagnoses.causal_hypothesis: The chat surface may normalize artifact type into a heading when line 1 is not explicitly reserved for prose sentence 1.

evidence_for: Forbidden categories are explicitly named in the runner.
evidence_against: Phase402 used essentially the same negative meta list and still returned a clean prose-only response.
residual_diagnoses.conclusion: Do not use this as the primary explanation; remove enumerated negative meta categories in the successor wrapper because they are unnecessary, not because causality is proven.

selected_architecture.mechanism: Keep the Phase403 literary payload byte-for-byte unchanged and replace only the chat response wrapper with a positive closed transaction.
transaction_invariants: The entire response is one fiction prose body.
There is no pre-prose label section.
After the final fiction sentence the response terminates immediately.
No markdown fence, JSON envelope, XML marker or writing-block wrapper is used.

checks: line 1 is prose rather than a category label
there is no text after the final fiction sentence
response contains exactly one prose body

selected_architecture.outer_prompt_strategy: Use a minimal execution prompt that points to the frozen runner and asks the model to execute it exactly, without repeating a list of forbidden meta categories.

falsifiable_prediction.prediction: If response-surface ambiguity/editor re-entry is the real residual cause, the single Phase404 A1 should return the same type of local fiction passage with no leading artifact label and no trailing assistant/editor material, without changing the literary payload.
falsifiable_prediction.failure_condition: Any title/preface/postscript/self-evaluation/explanation/editorial suggestion/second section still appears in the raw assistant output.
